picks.rationale: A terminal agent that draws and iterates UI via a /design command changes where frontend design work starts tomorrow — the most directly actionable item in the pool.
picks.excerpt: A walkthrough of five new UI/UX features in Claude Code, led by the /design command that lets the terminal agent draw and iterate on UI directly — shifting where frontend design work starts.

picks.rationale: Context-aware retopology that handles both organic and hard-surface meshes automates one of 3D's most tedious manual steps — a concrete pipeline change for Blender users.
picks.excerpt: Smart Remesh is a context-aware Blender add-on that turns both organic characters and hard-surface models into clean quad geometry while preserving vertex positions — automating one of 3D's most tedious steps.

picks.rationale: Theia turns 2D drawings into 3D CAD and builds human verification into the generation loop — a reusable pattern for anyone shipping AI output into production geometry.
picks.excerpt: Theia, Spare Parts 3D's tool that turns 2D drawings into 3D CAD models, avoids AI garbage output with an age-old trick: a human verification step built into the generation loop.

picks.rationale: Meta XR Operator lets coding agents build, test, debug and visually verify VR apps on their own — the first real closed loop for spatial prototyping teams.
picks.excerpt: Meta introduced Meta XR Operator, an experimental tool that lets AI coding agents autonomously build, test, debug and visually verify VR apps — closing the build-test-verify loop for spatial design teams.

picks.rationale: Figma's motion team demos path trim, a new Motion primitive — the craft layer designers still own while generated UI eats static layout.
picks.excerpt: Figma's motion team walks through path trim, one of the new Figma Motion primitives — the craft layer designers still own as generated UI takes over static layout.
